gale_shot.name: Gale Shot
gale_shot.description: A wind-carved arrow that strikes a single foe. High critical chance.

zephyr_blessing.name: Zephyr Blessing
zephyr_blessing.description: The glade's breath hastens every ally.

thorn_lash.name: Thorn Lash
thorn_lash.description: Barbed roots tear at a foe and leave poison behind.

stone_bulwark.name: Stone Bulwark
stone_bulwark.description: Raise a rampart of living stone around the whole team.

dawn_mend.name: Dawn Mend
dawn_mend.description: Warm dawnlight closes wounds and washes away afflictions.

radiance.name: Radiance
radiance.description: A burst of holy light scorches every enemy.

umbral_rend.name: Umbral Rend
umbral_rend.description: A claw of living shadow tears through armor.

nightfall.name: Nightfall
nightfall.description: A wave of hungry dark blinds and cuts every foe.

tidal_caress.name: Tidal Caress
tidal_caress.description: Cool water heals an ally and leaves a renewing tide.

frost_bind.name: Frost Bind
frost_bind.description: A lance of frozen tide slows a foe.

cinder_veil.name: Cinder Veil
cinder_veil.description: A cloak of cinders sharpens the caster's attacks.

shield_bash.name: Shield Bash
shield_bash.description: A blunt golden shield slams into a foe, sometimes stunning.

rally_cry.name: Rally Cry
rally_cry.description: A shouted oath lifts the whole team's attack.

wishlight.name: Wishlight
wishlight.description: A lantern's wish mends every ally a little.

blood_waltz.name: Blood Waltz
blood_waltz.description: A spinning cut that drinks the target's warmth.

web_bind.name: Web Bind
web_bind.description: Silken threads pin a foe in place.

venom_bite.name: Venom Bite
venom_bite.description: A quick bite that leaves a cruel venom.

tempest_dance.name: Tempest Dance
tempest_dance.description: Lyra becomes the storm and lets it choose every target at once.

worldroot.name: Worldroot
worldroot.description: The roots of the world itself rise to shelter the team.

starfall.name: Starfall
starfall.description: Seraphine opens the sky and lets the morning fall on her enemies.

eclipse_requiem.name: Eclipse Requiem
eclipse_requiem.description: A hymn to a moon that never rises. It drains the life from every foe.

abyssal_hymn.name: Abyssal Hymn
abyssal_hymn.description: The deep reef answers Coralyn's song with healing tides.

inferno_crown.name: Inferno Crown
inferno_crown.description: Ignis crowns a single foe in the fire of a dead kingdom.

aegis_dawn.name: Aegis Dawn
aegis_dawn.description: Mira raises an oath made visible: a wall of golden light.

thousand_lanterns.name: Thousand Lanterns
thousand_lanterns.description: Every wish Thistle ever collected lights at once.

crimson_eclipse.name: Crimson Eclipse
crimson_eclipse.description: Vespera's waltz ends with a single, impossible cut.

silk_dominion.name: Silk Dominion
silk_dominion.description: The web closes. Every foe feels the weaver's patience.

blazing_charge.name: Blazing Charge
blazing_charge.description: Kael burns everything behind him and everything ahead.

spark.name: Spark
spark.description: A stinging mote of wild magic.

hollow_wail.name: Hollow Wail
hollow_wail.description: A sound from inside the earth. It hurts to hear.

root_crush.name: Root Crush
root_crush.description: Ancient roots close around a single victim.

shadow_feint.name: Shadow Feint
shadow_feint.description: A cut from a direction that should not exist.

hollow_verdict.name: Hollow Verdict
hollow_verdict.description: The Elder Hollow judges every intruder at once.

corruption_bolt.name: Corruption Bolt
corruption_bolt.description: A bolt of purple corruption that eats through armor.

shadow_lash.name: Shadow Lash
shadow_lash.description: Whips of shadow strike all enemies.

soul_drain.name: Soul Drain
soul_drain.description: Drains life from a target, healing the Matron.

matron_verdict.name: Matron's Verdict
matron_verdict.description: The Fallen Matron unleashes her full corruption. Devastating to all.
